title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Livelihoods, Innovation, Food Security and Entrepreneurship (LIFE) programme will work in Grand Bassa and Riversess counties, Liberia. It aims to contribute to Concern Liberia's Food Systems for Food Security thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to increase rural economic development and food security in Liberia. The programme will support over 51,375 people living in extreme poor households including those headed by women, households with disabled members, landless households, households with children under five. This will be done through increasing access to agricultural extension and advisory services, increased adoption and diffusion of climate-smart adaptation practices by smallholder and subsistence farmers and, agriculture cooperatives, and women and youth groups.. Capacity Building 2: The main focus of this outcome is to strengthen the capacity of partners.
